profile.reading: This T5 Data Centers facility, T5 at Cleveland, sits in Cuyahoga County, Ohio. The operator own PDF fact sheet describes a single building totaling 187,000 square feet, with 142,000 square feet immediately available and more than 50,000 square feet of data center space. It states 2.5 MW N+1 currently available, expandable to 6 plus MW N+1, with 9.75 MW of total generator capacity and 6.5 MW N+1 generator redundancy, dual 34.5 kV electrical feeders, 275,000 gallon thermal energy storage tanks, and 62,000 gallons of fuel storage. The document describes SSAE 16, SOC 1 and SOC 2, and FISMA Moderate alignment. No street address is given in this source.
